name: regex_split_semantics
notes: Python re.split semantics: maxsplit limit (S1), no-match remainder (S2), zero-width consume-one-char incl. end-of-string trailing empty field (S3), and captured-group splicing incl. named groups (?P<...>). Harness links the REAL lib/libregex/hermes_regex.c; V event pins the joined field list from the shipped regex_split.
